windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path '.env')) { Copy-Item '.env.example' '.env'; 'created .env from .env.example' } else { '.env already exists' }

tasks.label: specra: db reset
tasks.command: docker compose down -v; docker compose up -d --wait

windows.command: $url = 'http://localhost:11434/api/tags'; $ok = $false; try { Invoke-WebRequest $url -TimeoutSec 10 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; $ok = $true } catch {}; if ($ok) { 'ollama already running'; exit 0 }; $exe = (Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $exe) { $exe = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Ollama\ollama.exe" }; if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { 'ollama is not installed - see https://ollama.com/download'; exit 1 }; Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList 'serve' -WindowStyle Hidden; foreach ($i in 1..60) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; try { Invoke-WebRequest $url -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing | Out-Null; "ollama up after ${i}s"; exit 0 } catch {} }; 'ollama did not start in 60s'; exit 1

linux.command: curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags >/dev/null && echo 'ollama already running' || { (ollama serve &) ; for i in $(seq 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags >/dev/null && { echo "ollama up after ${i}s"; exit 0; }; done; echo 'ollama did not start in 30s'; exit 1; }

osx.command: curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags >/dev/null && echo 'ollama already running' || { (ollama serve &) ; for i in $(seq 30); do sleep 1; curl -sf http://localhost:11434/api/tags >/dev/null && { echo "ollama up after ${i}s"; exit 0; }; done; echo 'ollama did not start in 30s'; exit 1; }

windows.command: $p = Get-Process ollama, 'ollama app' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { $p | Stop-Process -Force; "stopped $($p.Count) ollama process(es)" } else { 'ollama was not running' }

linux.command: pkill -f 'ollama serve' && echo 'stopped ollama' || echo 'ollama was not running'

osx.command: pkill -f 'ollama serve' && echo 'stopped ollama' || echo 'ollama was not running'

tasks.label: web: check (lint + types + tests)
tasks.command: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
